description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Batugammana, Moneragala D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720085 (24/0765)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extent measurements, and legal conditions affecting the titles. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
